meta.decision_rationale: Refusals record prototypes rejected at the ethical gate, preserving the identity signal each refusal sends.
tradeoffs: Refusing revenue-generating options constrains the budget
rejected_alternatives: Silently dropping rejected ideas (loses the learning signal)
Deferring all refusals to staff discretion (loses accountability)

refusals.opportunity_cost: Higher circulation numbers from an engagement-optimized recommendation feed.
refusals.identity_signal: The library does not let engagement metrics decide what knowledge is visible.

ethical_gate_assessment.question_1_value_violation_rationale: Ranking by engagement violates intellectual freedom by suppressing low-engagement but important works.
ethical_gate_assessment.question_2_harmful_practice_rationale: It reproduces filter-bubble dynamics the library exists to counter.
ethical_gate_assessment.question_3_unacceptable_dependency_ratio: It would create dependency on an opaque ranking model outside community control.

refusals.opportunity_cost: A major earmarked donation contingent on donor-directed acquisitions.
refusals.identity_signal: Collection priorities are set by the community, not by individual funders.

ethical_gate_assessment.question_1_value_violation_rationale: Donor-directed collection violates community voice by transferring curation authority to a single funder.
ethical_gate_assessment.question_2_harmful_practice_rationale: It normalizes pay-to-curate influence over a public institution.
ethical_gate_assessment.question_3_unacceptable_dependency_ratio: It creates financial dependency that could be withdrawn to coerce future decisions.
